name: Draw Moisture
body:
School transmutation [water]; Level druid 0, inquisitor 0, magus 0, psychic 0, ranger 1, shaman 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 10 feet
Target one object containing moisture up to a size of a 5-foot cube
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You draw water out of an object to clean up spills or quickly dry a soaked object, like clothing, wood floors or a precious document. The object is returned to a pre-wet state as long as it was soaked within the last hour. The spell dries an object weighing up to 5 lbs. The water collects into a floating globule floating in your hand. You can direct the globule into a receptacle while casting the spell or it splashes onto the ground. You can use repeated castings of this spell to dry larger objects. You can also use this spells to draw moisture in humid environments, thought you can only condense about 2 cups of water before depleting the ambient moisture in the area.
